d: Short, spiky platinum white hair with layered bangs framing a youthful, mature face and sharp, narrow blue eyes. A slender, athletic build is clad in polished silver plate armor over a royal blue tunic with gold accents, complemented by a long, flowing white cape with a blue lining and gold tassels. The outfit includes silver gauntlets, greaves, and a high metallic gorget, while the figure holds a sleek silver sword with an ornate crossguard.
